title: Affine characters and perpendicular twists
statement: Let $V$ be a linear subspace of the $n$-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb F_2$, let $a$ be a vector in that space, and let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the space. Then $f$ is a character indexed by some vector in the affine subspace $a+V$ if and only if the function obtained by multiplying $f$ pointwise by the character indexed by $a$ is a character indexed by some vector in $(V^\perp)^\perp$, where perpendicularity is with respect to the standard dot product over $\mathbb F_2$.
